body:
**On-Demand | 65 minutes**

How do you get full control over the steps, from design to your 3D printed part?  
Watch this webinar as we show you the tools for STL files that are optimised for additive manufacturing, while taking advantage of Stratasys colour and multi-material capabilities in Materialise Magics software.

Key Highlights:  
• Improve printability of STL files  
• Tips and tricks to optimize STL files  
• Texture mapping on STL file for polyJet
